title: ExPLoRA: Parameter-Efficient Extended Pre-Training to Adapt Vision Transformers under Domain Shifts
mechanism: Continue the VFM's own self-supervised objective (DINOv2) on unlabelled target-domain images, unfreezing 1-2 blocks and LoRA on the rest, then LoRA fine-tune.
evidence: R (abstract): SOTA on satellite imagery, beats full pretraining + fine-tune, up to +8% linear-probe top-1 with <10% of parameters.
adaptation: Continued DINO pretraining of DINOv2-L (or DINOv3-L) on the 11.9k server pool including 1,152 multi half-cells, so the encoder sees half-cut and scuff cells before supervision; then the VFM-H Rein-LoRA arm.
min_experiment: VFM-H with ExPLoRA-adapted backbone vs VFM-H with original backbone; metric E1 crack relF1@2 and CV crack relF1@2; kill if E1 not +0.02 over the original backbone.
prior_overlap: MIM and DDeP pretraining on ResNet-34 with the 11.9k pool were n.d.; continued VFM-objective pretraining of a ViT is a different mechanism and untested. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Continue DINOv2/v3 ViT-L SSL on the 159k CSIR/ARTS pool (crops 224-448, 1-ch to 3-ch, include the 1,152 multi half-cells so E1-like layouts are seen), then use as the Dino U-Net backbone.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm ExPLoRA-adapted ViT-L in Dino U-Net vs Dino U-Net with stock weights and vs PF, 5 seeds; metric CV crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2; kill if < +0.01 CV relF1@2 over stock and < +0.03 on E1. About 150 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Continue DINOv2 or DINOv3 ViT-L SSL on the 159k CSIR/ARTS pool (1-ch to 3-ch, crops 224 to 448 from 512 or native 1200 px), then use as the frozen backbone of the Dino U-Net arm.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm ExPLoRA-EL ViT-L in Dino U-Net vs the same with off-the-shelf DINOv3 vs PF, 5 seeds; metric E1 crack relF1@2 and test crack IoU; kill if ExPLoRA arm gains < +0.02 E1 relF1@2 over the off-the-shelf arm.

alt_notes.adaptation: Cheaper route to ViT-L continued pretraining on the pool on 8 A6000; feed into D24's VFM fine-tune.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Run only if MedDINOv3 or DINOCell arm shows a sign; same arm vs non-adapted VFM; kill if E1 crack recall < +0.02.
